articles.headline: Purdy and the 49ers build a big lead and hold on to beat the Commanders 23-17
articles.description: — Brock Purdy and the offense staked San Francisco to a big lead. The defense made sure the 49ers remained undefeated.

articles.headline: 49ers hold off furious Commanders' second-half rally to go 6-0
articles.description: The 49ers dominated in the first half but had to hold off a second-half Commanders rally.

images.name: George Kittle [1296x729]
images.caption: George Kittle caught an 11-yard touchdown pass from Brock Purdy, and the 49ers never looked back.

images.name: Jayden Daniels [1296x729]
images.caption: Jayden Daniels was sacked four times Monday, but he was able to rally the Commanders in the second half.

articles.headline: Mike Evans unable to finish 49ers' win, exits with Achilles soreness
articles.description: San Francisco wide receiver Mike Evans was unable to make it through Monday's night's 23-17 victory over Washington, leaving with a lingering bout of Achilles soreness that prevented the 49ers veteran from practicing Thursday, Friday and Saturday.

articles.headline: Commanders' Terry McLaurin carted off with knee injury in MNF loss to 49ers
articles.description: Terry McLaurin was carted off the field with his left leg in an air cast after injuring his knee against the 49ers. He'll undergo additional testing Tuesday.
